```{r warning=FALSE}
lcfs_year <- c(2016:2019,2021:2022)

lcfs <- load_lcf(
  year = lcfs_year,
  col_select = c(paste0("^", transport_codes$variable, "$"), other_variables),
  force_lower_case = TRUE
) 

cpi <- suppressMessages(load_cpi())
cpi$to2024 <- cpi$cpi[cpi$time == 2024] / cpi$cpi

lcfs <- lcfs %>% 
  left_join(
    cpi,
    by = c("my_year" = "time")
  )
```

```{r}

lcfs_transport <- lcfs %>% 
  select(case, my_year, transport_codes$variable) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = transport_codes$variable, names_to = "variable", values_to = "lcfs_value") %>%
  left_join(
    transport_codes %>% select(-c("description")),
    by = "variable"
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = (transport_codes %>% select(-c("variable", "description")) %>% names()), values_to = "my_coefficient", names_to = "my_variable") %>% 
  group_by(my_year, case, my_variable) %>% 
  summarise(my_value = sum(my_coefficient * lcfs_value), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "my_variable", values_from = "my_value") 

lcfs_transport <- lcfs %>% left_join(lcfs_transport, by = c("my_year", "case")) %>% ungroup()

# put labels on our new variables
for(v in transport_labels$variable) {
  label = transport_labels %>% filter(variable == v) %>% pull(label)
  lcfs_transport[[v]] <- labelled(lcfs_transport[[v]], label = label)
}

```


```{r make-equivalisation-factors}
eq_factors <- lcfs_transport %>% count(equiv_fact_common = p389p / eqincdop, a062, wt = weighta) %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% group_by(a062) %>% slice_head(n = 1) %>% select(equiv_fact_common, a062)

max_income <- lcfs_transport %>% group_by(my_year) %>% summarise(max_income = max(p389p), .groups = "drop")

lcfs_transport <- lcfs_transport %>% 
  left_join(eq_factors, by = "a062", suffix = c("OLDDROP", "")) %>% 
  left_join(max_income, by = "my_year", suffix = c("OLDDROP", "")) %>%
  select(-ends_with("OLDDROP")) %>% 
  mutate(
    r = p389p / eqincdop,
    eq_fact = case_when(
      p389p == max_income ~ equiv_fact_common,
      is.na(r) ~ equiv_fact_common,
      TRUE ~ p389p / eqincdop
    ),
    
    incomeVar = eqincdop * eq_fact, # Estimate income of higher income households based on their equivalised income and best guess equivalisation factor
    total_expenditure = p630tp
  )
```

```{r any_children}
lcfs_transport <- lcfs_transport %>% 
  mutate(
    n_kids = labelled(a040 + a041 + a042, label = "Number of children"),
    any_kids = labelled(ifelse(n_kids > 0, "Kids", "No kids"), label = "Any children"),
    single_parent = case_when(
      a062 %in% c(3, 4, 5, 6) ~ 1,
      n_kids > 0 ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ 3
    ) %>% 
      labelled(labels = c("Single parent" = 1, "Not single parent" = 2, "No kids" = 3), label = "Single parent")
  )
```

```{r make_income_deciles}
lcfs_transport <- lcfs_transport %>% 
  group_by(my_year) %>% 
  arrange(incomeVar) %>% 
  mutate(
    pos = (cumsum(weighta) - weighta / 2) / sum(weighta),
    incomeDecile = ceiling(pos * 10) %>% labelled(label = "Income decile (not equivalised)")
  ) %>% 
  arrange(eqincdop) %>% 
  mutate(
    pos_eq = (cumsum(weighta) - weighta / 2) / sum(weighta),
    incomeDecile_eq = ceiling(pos_eq * 10) %>% labelled(label = "Equivalised income decile")
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

```{r measure-functions}

analyse_annual_expenditure <- function(d, analysis_label_only = FALSE) {
  analysis_label <- "Expenditure (£2024)"
  vlab <- attr(d$target_variable, "label")
  d <- d %>% mutate(target_variable = (target_variable * to2024 * 365 / 7) %>% labelled(label = vlab))
  attr(d$target_variable, "metric") <- analysis_label
  attr(d$target_variable, "scale") <- "GBP"
  if(analysis_label_only) {
    analysis_label
  } else {
    d
  }
}

analyse_annual_expenditure_equivalised <- function(d, analysis_label_only = FALSE) {
  analysis_label <- "Expenditure (£2024 equivalised)"
  vlab <- attr(d$target_variable, "label")
  d <- d %>% mutate(target_variable = (target_variable * to2024 / eq_fact * 365 / 7) %>% labelled(label = vlab))
  attr(d$target_variable, "metric") <- analysis_label
  attr(d$target_variable, "scale") <- "GBP"
  if(analysis_label_only) {
    analysis_label
  } else {
    d
  }
}

analyse_share_total_expenditure <- function(d, analysis_label_only = FALSE) {
  analysis_label <- "Share of total expenditure"
  vlab <- attr(d$target_variable, "label")
  d <- d %>% mutate(target_variable = (target_variable / total_expenditure) %>% labelled(label = vlab))
  attr(d$target_variable, "metric") <- analysis_label
  attr(d$target_variable, "scale") <- "percent"
  if(analysis_label_only) {
    analysis_label
  } else {
    d
  }
}

analyse_share_income <- function(d, analysis_label_only = FALSE) {
  analysis_label <- "Share of income"
  vlab <- attr(d$target_variable, "label")
  d <- d %>% mutate(target_variable = (target_variable / incomeVar) %>% labelled(label = vlab))
  attr(d$target_variable, "metric") <- analysis_label
  attr(d$target_variable, "scale") <- "percent"
  if(analysis_label_only) {
    analysis_label
  } else {
    d
  }
}

exclude_zeros <- function(d) {
  vlab <- attr(d$target_variable, "label")
  vlab <- paste0(vlab, " (excluding zeros)")
  attr(d$target_variable, "label") <- vlab
  d %>% filter(target_variable > 0)
}

include_zeros <- function(d) {
  vlab <- attr(d$target_variable, "label")
  vlab <- paste0(vlab, " (including zeros)")
  attr(d$target_variable, "label") <- vlab
  d
}

my_labs <- function(d) {
  vlabel <- attr(d$target_variable, "label")
  glabel <- attr(d$grouping_variable, "label")
  mlabel <- attr(d$target_variable, "metric")
  this_scale <- attr(d$target_variable, "scale") 

  if(this_scale == "percent") {
    yscale = scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent)
    coord = coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.1, 1.5))
  }
  if(this_scale == "GBP") {
    yscale = scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar(prefix = "£"))
    coord = coord_cartesian()
  }
  
  list(
    labs(subtitle = mlabel, x = glabel, y = mlabel),
    yscale#,
    # coord
  )
}
```

```{r define-plots}

lcfs_mean_spend <- function(d, ylab = "Mean spend") {
  vlabel <- attr(d$target_variable, "label")
  # glabel <- attr(d$grouping_variable, "label")
 

  mean_tab <- d %>% 
    as_survey_design(weight = weighta) %>% 
    group_by(grouping_variable) %>% 
    summarise(mean_spend = survey_mean(target_variable, vartype = "ci"), .groups = "drop")
  
  plt <- mean_tab %>% 
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = as_factor(grouping_variable),
        y = mean_spend,
        ymax = mean_spend_upp,
        ymin = mean_spend_low
      )
    ) + 
    geom_col() + 
    geom_errorbar() + 
    #labs(title = vlabel, x = glabel, y = ylab)
    my_labs(d)
  
  #print(plt)
  plt
}

lcfs_mean_spend_no_zero <- function(d) {
  d %>% filter(target_variable > 0) %>% lcfs_mean_spend(ylab = "Mean spend (excl zeros)")
}

lcfs_boxplot <- function(d, exclude_outliers = TRUE) {
  vlabel <- attr(d$target_variable, "label")
  # glabel <- attr(d$grouping_variable, "label")
  
  # cat("\n\n## Boxplot spend - ", vlabel, "\n\n")
  
  plt <- d %>% 
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = as_factor(grouping_variable),
        y = target_variable,
        weight = weighta
      )
    ) + 
    # labs(title = vlabel, x = glabel, y = ylab)
    my_labs(d)
  
  if(exclude_outliers) {
    ylim <- d %>% 
      group_by(grouping_variable) %>% 
      summarise(
        median = reldist::wtd.quantile(target_variable, q = 0.5, weight = weighta, na.rm = T),
        p75 = reldist::wtd.quantile(target_variable, q = 0.75, weight = weighta, na.rm = T),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>% 
      mutate(
        med_plus_box_plus_whisker = median + 4 * (p75 - median)
      ) %>% 
      summarise(
        max_plot_value = max(med_plus_box_plus_whisker)
      )
    plt <- plt + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, ylim$max_plot_value))
  } else {
    plt <- plt + geom_boxplot()
  }
  
  # ylim1 = boxplot.stats(df$y)$stats[c(1, 5)]
  
  # print(plt)
  plt
}

lcfs_proportion_zero_table <- function(d) {
  

  prop_tab <- d %>% 
    as_survey_design(weight = weighta) %>% 
    group_by(grouping_variable, no_spend = target_variable == 0) %>%
    summarise(p_zero = survey_prop(vartype = "ci", proportion = TRUE), .groups = "drop") 
    
  prop_tab %>% filter(no_spend)
}

lcfs_proportion_zero_plot <- function(d) {
  vlabel <- attr(d$target_variable, "label")
  glabel <- attr(d$grouping_variable, "label")
  

  plt <- lcfs_proportion_zero_table(d) %>% 
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = as_factor(grouping_variable),
        y = p_zero,
        ymax = p_zero_upp,
        ymin = p_zero_low
      )
    ) + 
    geom_col() + 
    geom_errorbar() +
    labs(title = vlabel, x = glabel, y = "Proportion spending zero") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent)
  
  # print(plt)
  plt
}
```
